Package com.itmeansbigmountain.osrsapi

Class TempleApiClient

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.itmeansbigmountain.osrsapi.TempleApiClient
  • public class TempleApiClient
extends java.lang.Object
    Minimal TempleOSRS API helper for RuneLite and other OSRS Java projects.

    The client intentionally returns raw JSON strings so plugin authors can choose their own JSON library and data model. Every call uses a shared Java 11 HttpClient, a 10 second connection timeout, a 15 second request timeout, and the default OSRS-Plugin/1.0 user agent.
